jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
This part-time Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst role is a hybrid position based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with some flexibility for work from home. The role involves monitoring financial transactions and activities to detect potential fraud, money laundering, and other financial crimes. The analyst will conduct risk assessments, analyze patterns and anomalies, and prepare clear reports and recommendations for management and relevant stakeholders. Day-to-day tasks include using analytical and statistical tools to evaluate risk, supporting investigations, documenting findings, and collaborating with finance and compliance teams to strengthen internal controls and mitigate future risks.
Qualifications

Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in risk analysis and financial crime assessment.
Knowledge of finance, including basic financial principles and exposure to financial operations or services.
Ability to apply statistics and quantitative methods to detect patterns, trends, and anomalies in data.
Effective communication skills, including clear written reporting and the ability to explain complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Familiarity with fraud detection tools, transaction monitoring systems, or data analysis software is beneficial.
Understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices related to fraud prevention and anti–money laundering is an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, statistics, data analysis, business, or a related field preferred.
Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high ethical standards.

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Part-time

jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst is a part-time remote role focused on protecting Daily Motivational Quotes’ digital platforms and financial processes from fraud and abuse. In this role, the analyst reviews transactional and behavioral data to identify suspicious activity, evaluates potential financial crime risks, and recommends appropriate mitigation actions. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring alerts, conducting case investigations, preparing risk assessments, and documenting findings in clear reports. The analyst collaborates with internal stakeholders to refine controls, improve fraud detection rules, and support compliance with relevant policies. This position requires consistent, detail-oriented work and a proactive approach to spotting emerging patterns and threats.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Risk Analysis capabilities to identify, assess, and prioritize fraud and financial crime risks.
Candidates should possess solid Finance and Statistics skills to interpret transactional data, quantify risk exposure, and support evidence-based decision making.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to present findings clearly, write concise reports, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Candidates should possess attention to detail, integrity, and sound judgment when handling confidential information and sensitive investigations.
Relevant experience in fraud detection, financial crime analysis, compliance, or related fields is beneficial.
A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Criminal Justice, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
Familiarity with fraud monitoring tools, basic data analysis software, and online platform risk management is an advantage.

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Part-time

Industries
